dataList.dlg: Нет, Юная вагина, это я имею полное право, чтобы наша дорогая начальница СНАЧАЛА поиграла с моим достоинством. С какого это? Ты ходишь в моём теле—так что хватит о многом говорить и дай ей потрогать нас одновременно.

Young Sinclair!! Come thee to the cupboard...! Prithee, fetch down the cereal...! Who saw fit to place it при such a lofty height?!
<color=#8b9c15>... I did. Когда I used to be able to reach it. Now I can't.</color>
W-well, that's...
<color=#8b9c15>You know, если you'd actually bothered to read the fine print on the insurance, I wouldn't have been stuck like this...</color>

"Tangsuyuk". "Yukgaejang"! "Jambon-beurre". Re... "Reblochon on potato gratin"! Ugh... Tang... "Tangbao"...? O... "Omurice"! What sayest thou to that? Heh. "Smørrebrød". Ehhhh?! "Ble"? "Bro"? What manner of food is that?! It's an open-faced sandwich. Все right, then. Guess you're buying lunch today. *groan* Very well. I shall fetch some omurice... to go.

Nnngh...! *huff* *huff* Every evening... 'tis the same nightmare—those wretches tearing young Sinclair limb from limb, again и again...
<color=#8b9c15>...? Did you call me?</color>
Ah, n-nay! 'Tis nothing, nothing при все!

<color=#8b9c15>... Don Quixote, please tell me you haven't forgotten the upcoming insurance renewal.</color>
Hm?! N-nay, of course not...!
<color=#8b9c15>... And go over the add-ons. I swear, если you forget to get the clone body's growth shots covered again, I'm gonna... *sigh*</color>
'Twas my fault, forsooth... Have I not admitted my guilt often enough...?

Ugh... You know, you're getting insufferable. Nobody said you were wrong или anything. Verily, we ought to give him some space, young Sinclair... He hath yet to recover... No, enough is enough. Все we said was we'll work together on this one job 'cause Fixers who think like you aren't a good fit for our Office, simple as that. And you had to be a miserable ass about it out of the blue! Could you please... never mind. Look, you little—stop frowning already, would you?

A wedge, thou seest, is a weapon most divorced from cleaving и crushing. Behold the pinpoint-keen tip of this spear mine: dost thou see?! 'Tis a weapon of unparalleled efficiency! A strike most singular и focus most fine requireth little strength to execute. Such is the work befitting a "Wedge!" Consequently! Those who seek our Office with a quest in their bosom expect no brute strength, nay; 'tis swiftness и precision... founded upon the bedrock of shrewd и precise situational assessment! Heh heh, that is what our Office is!

<color=#8b9c15>Not exactly the kind of situation where we can afford to be polite. I'll get to skewering you right away.</color>
As a Fixer, I can scarce afford proper etiquette когда lives stand при stake! Surely thou canst understand!

<color=#8b9c15>Our Office есть particularly low tolerance for dickheads who like to dress themselves up as "selfless." Doubly so когда the most selfish of them don't seem to realize that himself.</color>

<color=#8b9c15>... How long is that punk going to leech on our Office?</color>
Prithee, practice patience! Thou recallest Lady Outis's reassurance, dost thou not? He shall depart anon following this contract's completion.

Хватит глазеть на нас, злой педофил! Хмф... Хватит! 
<color=#ffef23>Хех хех, ты ведь понимаешь, что НАША любимая тётя Отис уже едет сюда на фургоне без номеров? Ты станешь нашим партнёром в груминге!</color>
В сторону, юный Синклер! Дай мне почухать их туза своим лансером!
Я должна показать им прелести груминга!
У меня есть цель и мечта - найти богатого старого мужичка и потом забрать себе наследство, а после я смогу пёхать Юного Синклера!
Соси!
Открывай ротик шире, мистер Педо!
Guh... 'Tis wearing me down.
Hoh! 'Twas quite easily read!
Such... a grave mistake...
Hoyday! Perchance thou hast forgotten someone to credit for thine success? I daresay the first half was made possible only thanks to my—!!
Have I not warned thee, that thine approach was misguid—

Phew... That be one quest behind us! What sayest thou, young Sinclair, to a moment's respite?
<color=#8b9c15>We still have some headaches чтобы нанести with, but... Eh, it's whatever при this point, right?</color>

<color=#8b9c15>They gave us some trouble, but—</color>
—verily, один раз accepted, no contract is beyond us!
<color=#8b9c15>Yeah, this contract was also—</color>
—settled in the Wedgiest fashion!
<color=#8b9c15>ARRRGH!!!!! Holy shit, can you stop cutting me off for one damn second?!</color>

<color=#8b9c15>Damn punk... I knew he'd hightail it the moment shit hit the fan...</color>
Alas... 'twas an expected outcome, was it not...?
<color=#8b9c15>Tsk, don't talk...! You're gonna теряет more blood than insurance's willing to cover...</color>
